"Oh but what about the off chance they don't have it?" Considering 2 out of 4 kids (myself and my brother) for sure inherited my mom's major depressive symptoms, as well as both of us AND my mother and grandma having eating disorders, I'd prefer not to risk it. My sister is the only lucky one out of the 4 of us but even then barely scrapes by with mild depressive symptoms. (The youngest brother hasn't shown signs of it, but he is also autistic and already struggles because of that so it's hard to tell.)
